source_title: 호드 갤길 영포티 전탱 길드추방당함 ㅋㅋ
subtitle: 줄파락 도안 하나에 협박·파탈·길드추방

cuts.speaker: 트롤 주술사
cuts.dialogue:
줄파락 퀘 30분 기다렸다…
외부인 있으니 매너 겜하자!
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle establishing shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal sandy Zul'Farrak stone floor touch. On the left, exasperated Troll Shaman guild master (totem staff stowed on back) taps her foot impatiently with arms crossed. On the right, Orc Warrior tank holding a compact one-handed sword and sturdy steel shield jogs up late with an unapologetic smirk.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
앗 대장 도안 획귀였네?!
2시간 거래로 바로 줄게!
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder two-shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal sandy dungeon floor touch and open white space on the upper right. On the left, flustered Human Warlock (spellbook stowed) apologetically holds out a glowing blue rolled parchment blueprint scroll (zero text) with both hands while her cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker (starry belly, gold bracers) bows apologetically beside her. On the right foreground, Orc Warrior tank gripping her compact one-handed sword and sturdy steel shield glares darkly.

equip_effects: 사용 효과: 강철 수호자의 판금 장갑 제작법을 배웁니다.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
빨리 내놔, 안 그러면
후회하게 해줄게. 걍 쫑내!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle confrontation shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal sandy stone touch. On the left, furious Orc Warrior tank thrusts her sturdy steel shield forward and points her compact one-handed sword aggressively with blazing crimson eyes and angry steam puffs. On the right, bewildered Human Warlock (spellbook stowed) and her cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker (starry belly, gold bracers) flinch backward sweating profusely.

Dutch-tilt extreme big bust-up close-up filling 80 percent of frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with stark vertical shock lines. Troll Shaman on the left and Human Warlock on the right (with her cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker peeking wide-eyed beside her) freeze side-by-side in speechless deadpan shock with tiny blank dot pupils, open jaws, and cold sweat drops.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
흥, 기분 상해서 못 하겠네.
파탈하고 바로 접종한다!
cuts.visual_prompt: Back-view three-quarter shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal sandy ground touch. On the left, petty sulking Orc Warrior tank (compact one-handed sword and sturdy steel shield strapped on back) marches away huffing with puffed cheeks and arms crossed as she fades in a pale cyan disconnect shimmer. On the right, furious Troll Shaman guild master (totem staff stowed on back) trembles with fiery anger sparks around her head.

cuts.speaker: 트롤 주술사
cuts.dialogue:
외부인 있는데 매너 좀 지켜라!
탱 바로 길드 추방!
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile wide comic finale in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal sandy floor touch. On the left, furious Troll Shaman guild master (totem staff stowed on back) dramatically rips a blank red guild parchment scroll (zero text) in half with fiery indignation sparks. On the right, Human Warlock (spellbook stowed) watches awkwardly holding the rolled blueprint scroll while her cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker (starry belly, gold bracers) nods approvingly beside her.
